expectations.evidence: Two-node service graph SGT_PaloAlto_F5 with Node1=PaloAlto (GoTo, Routed, PBR) then Node2=F5 (GoTo, Routed). Rationale: PA decrypts/inspects before F5 load balances.
PA-5400 HA pair in active/passive mode with HA1 control, HA2 data (ethernet1/3), HA3 packet forwarding (ethernet1/4), preemption disabled, link/path monitoring configured.

Three zones defined: Untrust (ethernet1/1, internet-facing), DMZ (ethernet1/2, toward F5), Management (MGT). Inter-zone policies include Allow_Inbound_HTTPS (Untrust->DMZ), Deny rules, and explicit deny-all.

SSL Inbound Inspection mode with imported server cert+private key, decryption policy RULE_Decrypt_Inbound_HTTPS from Untrust to DMZ on TCP/443, TLS 1.2/1.3, re-encryption to F5, blocking expired/untrusted certs.

vs_dmz_web_https (10.10.200.10:443, pool_web_servers), vs_dmz_api_https (10.10.200.11:443, pool_api_gateways), SSL profile ssl_client_dmz, health monitors mon_http_web/mon_http_api with 5s interval/16s timeout.
i5800 HA pair in active/standby with device group dg_dmz (sync-failover), connection mirroring, MAC masquerade, failover on link loss.
PBR policies defined: PBR_PaloAlto_Consumer/Provider and PBR_F5_Consumer/Provider with health checks. PBR redirects contract traffic through service graph nodes for service insertion.
Contracts CON_Web_to_App (TCP/8080,8443), CON_API_to_App (TCP/8080,8443), CON_App_to_DB (TCP/5432,3306). No contract between Web/API and DB (implicit deny). Whitelist model enforced.
Full path documented: Internet -> ISP/Border Router -> ACI L3Out -> PBR -> PA-5400 (Untrust->DMZ) -> F5 i5800 -> EPG_Web/EPG_API -> EPG_App -> EPG_DB with return path via same chain.
requirements.yml lists cisco.aci >=2.9.0, paloaltonetworks.panos >=2.19.0, f5networks.f5_modules >=1.28.0. Playbook structure and inventory defined for all components.
ACI health scores monitored per-Tenant/EPG/interface with alert below 90. PA threat logs sent to SIEM via syslog. F5 pool member health tracked via health monitors and Telemetry Streaming.
L4-L7 Device Packages section documents Palo Alto PANOS device package and F5 BIG-IP device package both imported to APIC, listed under tenant structure and device registration tables.
